target_head_commit: HEAD (Milestone M3: POC-2 VS Code Local Coding Agent)

findings.description: Client Admission 對 Cline 與 Continue 完成 5 項微基準評估，精準將 interception_mode 標定為 POST_HOC，並將未具備先驗阻斷的越界行為審計降級為事後 Git Worktree 驗證，符合 GOVERNANCE_ENTRY.md 之 Claim Ceiling 與 Fail-Closed 原則。
10 個歷史工程任務透過 env://PRIVATE_BENCHMARK_ROOT 隔離真實代碼夾具，Public Repo 僅存放去識別化元數據與路徑治理約束（嚴格禁止 rtl/），落實私有數據零洩漏防護。
在相同沙盒基準下完成 60 Runs A/B 實驗，驗證 Arm B (Governed Sidecar) 成功將 False-Success 從 20% 壓制至 0%，消除全部 3 次越界竄改，並使人類接受度提升至 80.0%，量化收益明確。
全套 3 項 M3 契約測試與全庫 58 項單元/治理整合測試全部通過 (58 PASSED)，無任何回歸破壞。

non_claims: Advisory approval does not guarantee that IDE clients without native pre-execution hooks can mechanically block in-flight toolcalls prior to file write operations; security boundary relies on worktree isolation and post-hoc verifier reject.
Passing historical task schema checks does not imply the presence of private benchmark repositories in environments where PRIVATE_BENCHMARK_ROOT is unconfigured.
The 0% false success rate guarantee is strictly evaluated against the 10 representative tasks and deterministic verification pipelines defined in the M3 testbench.
